purpose: Unscored, audit-only enumeration of the r0 operational input law. No FIT cases, DEV entropy, DEV cases, policy program, facility, scorer or sealed historical matching index is used.
audit_seed_rule: SHA-256(UTF-8 tag || 0x00 || original public T8 development root bytes); use as unsigned big-endian generator seed. This is a third namespace for building audit witnesses only. The registered FIT seed is used solely to reserve its scheduled profile tuples analytically. No formal FIT or DEV inputs are generated.
counting_rule: Enumerate one full no-replacement profile order per family after reserving both FIT blocks of profiles. Generate every complete candidate block on the frozen original condition entry, then apply the r0 shift and window overlay. Verify original 12-cell and maintenance quotas, shared twin profile, injectivity of profile-to-block, and full / v3 operative / T3-normalized core identities. Record any unusable blocks. This yields a constructive finite capacity bound for a single panel, not the total number of all seeds or an official novelty PASS.
historical_bound: Use the complete r0 declared gross catalogue membership as a conservative historical debit, counting even documented aliases. An old case can exclude at most one enumerated block per family: every tested comparable map keeps the two real workforce shift intervals, and no two blocks in the same audit family share a tuple. This argument includes old full, same-schema operative and normalized legacy common-core equality simultaneously. No access to H3 (including its index) or H2. The actual official split must still pass its independently controlled, single-use full and operative comparison; an incomplete historical inventory or incomparable schema blocks release.

structure.population: Compute summaries for the entire finite audit pool and its predetermined first 38 complete blocks per family; never select a prefix for desirable diversity. No output of a scored policy is observed.
structure.fault_projection: Block counts of absent vs present external challenge, and separately a histogram of exact exogenous onset seconds including NONE. These are generator inputs, not L>0 or any policy's service event.
structure.opportunity_projection: Use the original public Gate.admit for a prospective first direct action on LB (London) or NR (Netherlands) from the same idle, no-previous-issue public state at each 60-second decision tick. Only records already arrived enter this gate. Record first and last legal issue tick, number of legal ticks, required initial active work and the independently identified last tick that could finish strictly before the external challenge. With no fault this last field is NA. This is an input-side opportunity envelope; no policy, plant, actual prior dispatch, exercise of a permit, service loss or personnel score is simulated.
structure.service_projection: Within each block, count rows by the joint tuple of fault onset/duration or NONE, maintenance exposure, number and last time of legally completable preventive ticks before fault, and number of distinct original pre-fault prior-notice sources. No case ID, raw hash, seed or private cause label is used as diversity.
structure.work_projection: Within each block, count rows by (first legal issue, last legal issue, number of legal issues, initial work duration) with explicit NONE. The structure uses genuine available work, excluding exogenous fault labels and never substituting expected work for actual person-seconds.
structure.primary_cluster_signature: For each twelve-row block take (number of external shocks, number of shocks at the earlier of the two frozen onset values = 1500 s, number of shocked rows with any legally completable pre-shock issue tick, number of shocked rows with 1..3 such ticks, number of rows with no legal issue tick anywhere). These are coarse interpretable counts. Do not include row ordering, labels, raw shift IDs, seed, full bytes, or scores. Same five integers = same structural cluster within a family. This definition and the threshold were set before enumeration.
structure.design_threshold: At least eight distinct primary signatures per family in the audited candidate pool. Report the predetermined first 38 blocks and all nonoverlapping 38-block windows separately (no choosing windows). A pool below eight requires revision/review. This gate does not veto a nonzero-variance DEV endpoint.
metrics: number of distinct permutation-invariant block histograms
probability that two different audit blocks have the same histogram
inverse-Simpson effective number of structural patterns
separate minima, maxima and distributions for shock counts/times and windows
structure.limits: Actual L>0, paid decisions, service differences and personnel, realized R/O output, exact future DEV data and observed DEV variance are all unavailable. Input structural variation and outcome variance are different quantities.

scope_stop: Stage A may export only the audit's aggregated block features, identity-chain commitments and counts. The audit data are outside both study splits and unavailable to either eventual search. Do not query or consume either official overlap release.
